note: Hosting/Cloud Provider Attribution Reference seed — Tier-1 hyperscale only (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud). SMALLEST DEFENSIBLE dataset to validate the HPR attribution model. Two key types: IP_RANGE_CONTAINMENT (representative real prefixes drawn from each provider's authoritative published range file) + ASN_EXACT (RIR-registered ASNs). Attribution-only; no scoring/ranking/reputation/quality. Hand-authored from documentary sources; no build script. provider_class documentary/non-scoring.
scope_note: Tier-1 hyperscale only (founder-authorised scope). No managed-hosting/colocation/long-tail providers in v1. ip_ranges are a representative subset of each provider's published file (sufficient to validate the model), NOT the exhaustive range set — exhaustive ranges are an implementation-phase concern (full published-file ingestion). Provenance (file URL + snapshot token/date) recorded per range group.

freeze.release_authority: Founder / Governance Architect (Founder Dataset Freeze Review 2026-06-23)
freeze.documentary_verification: All three providers verified 2026-06-23 against their own authoritative published range files (AWS ip-ranges.json; Azure Service Tags Public; Google Cloud cloud.json) fetched over HTTPS, plus RIR-registered ASNs. Published-file URLs + snapshot tokens recorded per entry.
freeze.revalidation_at_freeze: PASS — validate-seed.js 17/17 (IP_RANGE_CONTAINMENT, ASN_EXACT, precedence range>ASN + longest-prefix, CONFLICT, UNMAPPED, determinism; governance: provider_id unique, ASN disjoint, valid CIDRs, no cross-provider overlap, provenance complete, no prohibited fields).
freeze.immutability: Immutable per HPR-001 §8.1 from this freeze. Authoritative for new runs. Expansion only via strict-superset successor (HPR-DATA-002): existing HCP-001..003 mappings preserved byte-identical; additive only; backward-compatible; range-snapshot refresh = a governed version event.
freeze.scope_at_freeze: Tier-1 hyperscale only (founder scope). AS15169 (broad Google) deliberately excluded (H-E1 over-broad). Representative (not exhaustive) ranges — exhaustive published-file ingestion is an implementation-phase concern, not a freeze blocker.

entries.evidence_source: Published range file https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json (createDate 2026-06-22-22-27-05, syncToken 1782167225 — AWS system-of-record, authoritative). ASNs AS16509 (AMAZON-02) + AS14618 (AMAZON-AES), RIR-registered (ARIN). Verified 2026-06-23.

Published range file 'Azure IP Ranges and Service Tags – Public Cloud' (Microsoft Download Center id=56519 → ServiceTags_Public_20260615.json, changeNumber 405, cloud=Public; AzureCloud service tag). ASN AS8075 (MICROSOFT-CORP-MSN-AS-BLOCK), RIR-registered (ARIN). IP_RANGE_CONTAINMENT is the precise primary key (AzureCloud); AS8075 corroborates (Microsoft-operated network). Verified 2026-06-23.

Published range file https://www.gstatic.com/ipranges/cloud.json (creationTime 2026-06-23T07:09:24, syncToken 1782223764283 — GCP-specific, the correct file for cloud attribution). ASN AS396982 (GOOGLE-CLOUD-PLATFORM), RIR-registered. NOTE: AS15169 (GOOGLE, broader — carries consumer Search/Gmail/YouTube) is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED as an over-broad shared key (HPR-001 H-E1 / E3-analogue): it would conflate consumer-Google-served endpoints with Google Cloud hosting. cloud.json + AS396982 are the GCP-specific keys. Verified 2026-06-23.
